CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a slow push with a simultaneous barely-perceptible dutch roll on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm, framing with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
